name: view_difficulty_named
description: A level other than Normal is named wherever the mode is (M8, design 2.6, 5.5, 5.6, 5.8; contract-m8 §3): a Hard party queued with open seats meets two strangers at Hard, and Match Found says 'High Water · Hard · 4 players · ~13 min'; the loading title 'HIGH WATER  ·  HARD  ·  WICKHOLLOW  ·  12 waves' (MATCH_CONFIG's level); the Esc menu in the match 'High Water · Hard · Wickhollow'; the results' subtitle 'High Water · Hard · ...'. Back in the hub, Try's tooltip says the Try plays Hard; offline the Esc menu names Hard too, and the results count the lives out of the level's own ('15 of 15 lives left' at Hard). At Normal and in a duel no level is named.

steps.msg: Match Found names the party's level

steps.assert: node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').find_child('LoadingTitle', true, false).text == 'HIGH WATER  ·  HARD  ·  WICKHOLLOW  ·  12 waves'
steps.msg: the loading title names MATCH_CONFIG's level

steps.wait_until: Session.state_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and Game.sim != null and scene.client != null and scene.client.phase_name() == 'IN_MATCH'

steps.assert: node('MatchMenu').visible and node('MenuMatch').text == 'High Water · Hard · Wickhollow'
steps.msg: the Esc menu names the match's level

steps.wait_until: scene_path() == 'res://scenes/hub.tscn' and node('HubPanel') != null and Session.state_name() == 'HUB'

steps.assert: node('Try').tooltip_text == 'A solo practice match with this Builder, offline, at Hard'
steps.msg: Try's tooltip says the Try plays the hub's level

steps.assert: node('MatchMenu').visible and node('MenuMatch').text == 'High Water · Hard · Wickhollow'
steps.msg: offline the Esc menu names it too

steps.assert: resource('res://scripts/ui/results_panel.gd').compute(scene.sim, ['Sascha'], 'won', {}, 'high_water')['detail'].begins_with('High Water · Hard · 12 waves · ') and resource('res://scripts/ui/results_panel.gd').compute(scene.sim, ['Sascha'], 'won', {}, 'high_water')['detail'].ends_with(' · 15 of 15 lives left')
steps.msg: the results count the lives out of the level's own

steps.assert: node('Try').tooltip_text == 'A solo practice match with this Builder, offline'
steps.msg: at Normal no level is named
a duel plays Normal: no level named
